who: Cybersecurity learners and instructors who need short-lived, repeatable vulnerable labs without exposing host files or control-plane secrets.
agent_work: The agent generates a bounded stdlib SQL-injection challenge in a fresh Celesto computer, verifies it privately, publishes only the target port, and cleans it up.
proof_output: A private exact-flag comparison, an external HTTP probe, a revocation result, and an independently confirmed guest deletion record.
